h1: White House Hotel Suphanburi — the roadside stop where you always sleep well
intro: Driving the Suphan–Song Phi Nong road late at night, eyes getting heavy, looking for somewhere to crash without detouring into town · White House Hotel Suphanburi is a white-block hotel on the main road in Song Phi Nong that drivers love to pull into — the appeal is refreshingly simple: plenty of parking, clean rooms, comfortable beds and breakfast included, from around ฿700/night · not a fancy boutique, but it does the job of a stopover hotel well.

Front of the white hotel building by the road with a large parking lot

body.html: White House Hotel Suphanburi sits at 99/1 Moo 3, Thung Khok, Song Phi Nong — right on a busy main road, its white building visible from a distance · It's a 3-storey building with around 21 rooms split into Standard, Deluxe and VIP categories · The thing guests mention most in reviews is the wide parking lot out front, with room to spare — for anyone travelling by car, that's a genuine advantage.

Rooms earn praise for being clean and more spacious than the price suggests · The Standard room comes with AC, a flat-screen TV, fridge, a work desk and drinking water · The comfortable bed is another point that drivers arriving after a long day single out — they sleep well and wake up without a sore back · Deluxe and VIP rooms are larger and some have a balcony, a good shout if you want more space for a small step up in price.
"Drove a long way, stayed just one night — clean room, soft bed, loads of parking. Had breakfast in the morning and carried on. Great value."

Breakfast is included and offers Thai rice soup, bread and an American-style set · Reviews are fairly consistent that the breakfast is basic — filling but nothing special · If you're expecting a big buffet you may be let down, but for a hotel at this price, having breakfast at all helps you save the first meal of the day.

Worth knowing before you book: the building is 3 storeys but there's no lift — if you land an upper-floor room with heavy bags, be ready to carry them yourself · Some reviews mention a bathroom smell and slow drainage in certain rooms, which is the kind of thing you see at this tier · If you're booking on the spot, ask to see the room first and request a change if there's an issue.

White House's location suits people passing through more than those set on sightseeing in Suphan Buri town · It's in Song Phi Nong district, a fair drive from the main attractions like Sam Chuk Market or Bueng Chawak — you'll need to drive on · But if your plan is a stopover on the Bangkok–Suphan–Kanchanaburi route, or a cheap base to sleep before pushing on, it delivers at an easy price.

The honest verdict, compiled from real guest reviews: White House Hotel Suphanburi is a stopover hotel that nails the basics — clean, good beds, easy parking, breakfast thrown in · Don't expect stylish design or a full suite of facilities, but measured on value for a single night by the road, it's a choice you can settle into with peace of mind.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — White House Hotel Suphanburi

faq.q: Where is White House Hotel Suphanburi · is it in Suphan Buri town?
faq.a: It's at 99/1 Moo 3, Thung Khok, Song Phi Nong, Suphan Buri — right on the main road, not in Suphan Buri town itself · about a 40-minute drive from the town centre · It suits people passing through or wanting an overnight stop more than a sightseeing base in town.

faq.q: How much is White House Hotel · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿700/night for a Standard room · Deluxe is around ฿1,200 and VIP around ฿2,200 · all rooms include breakfast · Prices vary by season and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is White House Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for self-drive travellers wanting one comfortable night on the way through · wide parking, clean rooms, comfy beds, breakfast included · Less ideal if you're set on the town, Sam Chuk Market or Bueng Chawak, since you'll have to drive on.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a lift · is there parking?
faq.a: The building is 3 storeys with no lift — with heavy bags, ask for a ground-floor room · There's a large free lot in front with plenty of space, a point reviewers praise often.

faq.q: What's breakfast like at White House Hotel · is it included?
faq.a: Breakfast is included in the room rate, with Thai rice soup, bread and an American set · Reviews say it's basic — filling but not very varied — handy for saving the first meal before you set off.
